# Code Anchors: Household Data Writes

- `src/services/firestoreData.ts` — the creation of stores and items, the all-or-nothing write of new and re-listed items, the item update, and the category-only item update
- `src/services/types.ts` — the data service's store and item saves, and the category-only update
- `src/data/model.ts` — the shape of a re-listed item
- `src/app/saveWait.ts` — the 8-second wait for the server and the retry-safe record ID
- `firestore.rules` — allows a member to create stores, create items and update items, and refuses every other write to household data from the app
- `rules-tests/firestore.rules.test.ts` — tests each allowed and refused save, including the 50-item write and the re-list update
- `rules-tests/categoryDrop.rules.test.ts` — tests the category-only update from a member and its refusal from outsiders
